description: Auto-merge policy: auto-merge every update once CI is green and the release is at least three days old, including major updates.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge all updates once CI passes

Wait three days after a release before raising its PR. Auto-merge plus required checks would otherwise land a compromised release as soon as CI went green; most are caught and yanked within a day or two. internalChecksFilter strict holds the PR back until the age passes, because platform auto-merge does not wait for Renovate's own pending stability check. Security fixes are unaffected: vulnerability alerts ignore minimumReleaseAge by default.
No wait for this account's own releases (shared workflows, dev-container images): they are built and reviewed here, and holding them back only delays fixes rolling out.
